description.value: The Stable House Bistro is a community-founded wine bar and bistro in Vancouver's South Granville neighbourhood, named to honour the historic stable structures that dotted the area over a century ago. The kitchen centres on seasonal, locally sourced sharing plates built around signature in-house charcuterie boards, while the eclectic wine list is curated by one of BC's top sommeliers with a focus on unpretentious everyday European wines. It is part of a small local restaurant group that also operates Brasserie Coquette and Fiore Famiglia, all within a short distance of each other in the same neighbourhood.
